agentGuide: GraphQL only: POST /graphql with {"query": "...", "variables": {...}}. Me: { viewer { id name } }. My issues: { viewer { assignedIssues(first: 20, filter: { state: { type: { nin: ["completed","canceled"] } } }) { nodes { identifier title priority state { name } url } } } }. Search: { issues(filter: { title: { containsIgnoreCase: "..." } }, first: 10) { nodes { identifier title url } } }; one by key: { issue(id: "ENG-123") { title description state { name } comments { nodes { body user { name } } } } }. Teams and states: { teams { nodes { id name states { nodes { id name } } } } }. Create: mutation { issueCreate(input: { teamId: "...", title: "...", description: "..." }) { issue { identifier url } } }; update: mutation { issueUpdate(id: "...", input: { stateId: "..." }) { success } }; comment: mutation { commentCreate(input: { issueId: "...", body: "..." }) { success } }. The key is set by Allkin.
